description: Mace describes using IESVE on more than 70 public-sector projects since 2021. Applications include schools, prisons, barracks and healthcare buildings. The narrative covers Revit geometry transfer, recurring building profiles, roof and photovoltaic analysis, school overheating assessments and comparisons of fabric and heating measures for refurbishment. It also describes using IESVE outputs to communicate energy and comfort results to clients. This is a portfolio workflow account. The separate Manchester Anchorage case has a specific asset scope and is not treated as the same resource. This public HTML case narrative is published by IES and can be read without payment. Its reuse licence is not stated. Access to the described software, input data and project models is not established by the public page. The source does not give a complete study period or all spatial and temporal model resolutions. Reported results are provider claims and have not been independently reproduced. The case supports the documented infrastructure simulation use and is linked to the named modelling resources. Only metadata and the case description were inspected; no data or model files were downloaded.
